# Phase Three — Tiferes Exact File Strategy

## Read Before Any Rewrite
- Wallet product-credit service, validation, routes and route table.
- Transaction runner/store invariants.
- Existing async/job/provider gateways.
- Transcribe API/controller/view contracts.
- Canonical app/game catalog and commerce manifests.
- Current sitemap/SEO/build scripts.
- Global foundation, commerce CSS and product shell boot.

## Prefer New Small Modules
- `api/wallet/core/commerce/productCreditReservations.js`
- `api/wallet/core/commerce/productCreditReservationService.js`
- `api/wallet/routes/commerceCreditReserve.js`
- `api/wallet/routes/commerceCreditCommit.js`
- `api/wallet/routes/commerceCreditRelease.js`
- `shared/commerce/paidActionClient.js`
- `shared/commerce/PaidActionCoordinator.js`
- readiness/SEO generators in dedicated script submodules.

## Existing Files Rewrite Only When Required
- wallet route map to expose new endpoints.
- shared commerce boot/controller only when adoption contract requires it.
- product-specific controller only after full read and dirty-diff inspection.
